load_lvis_json: load an LVIS JSON annotation file and return a list of dicts in Detectron2 standard format
register_lvis_instances: register an LVIS dataset with the Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for instance detection
get_lvis_instances_meta: get LVIS metadata including thing_classes for a given dataset name like lvis_v0.5 or lvis_v1
run_lvis_data_vis: run the LVIS dataset loader CLI to visualize annotations on images and save them to a directory
review_load_lvis_json: review the load_lvis_json function to understand how it parses LVIS annotations into Detectron2 format
